integrity: Two exact-integer scripts, full definitions and proof, bibliographic source references, and review/verification limits are provided.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the additive ternary palette only and simple cycles of order at least three.
The infinite-rank formula is proved algebraically; finite computer checks do not independently certify all orders.
A bounded published-literature comparison does not exclude an unindexed equivalent calculation.
title: A period-three Fourier rank resonance for proper ternary cycle colourings
